lead.headline: 8D Starts Four Zeros, Wins
lead.deck: Left 71.68 on the bench and still won by 36.9.
paragraphs: {T3} started Dart, Skattebo, McLaurin and Tate, all projected for zero. Chase 31.1, Jacobs 23.2 and McBride 20.2 did the rest.
{S6} posted a season-low 52.6, went 0–11 in all-play and lost a fourth straight. {S3} has won two in a row after an 0–6 start.

sidebar.title: The Bench Back Went Off
sidebar.text: {S2} benched Tyler Allgeier for 36.1. The two backs who started, Jeremiyah Love and J.K. Dobbins, combined for 3.6.

11-12.headline: Kazakhstan Takes Down No. 1
11-12.text: Hubbard 24.9, Nacua 25.0, Steelers D/ST 16.0. Mahomes 25.44 sat behind Burrow.

5-1.headline: Swift Ends the Streak
5-1.text: Swift 27.9, new pickup Jaguars D/ST 21.0. Tuten's 29.9 wasn't enough for Chimpanzini.

9-10.headline: Pickup Pays Off Again
9-10.text: New add Jonah Coleman 20.4 on a 7.0 projection. Pony left nothing on the bench.

3-6.headline: See Page One
3-6.text: Michael Wilson 26.8 and Bo Nix 19.28 watched from the 8D bench.

2-4.headline: Higgins Goes for 37.5
2-4.text: Tee Higgins 37.5 from the flex, Fannin 23.4. Bruisers drop to 1–7.

8-7.headline: Blowout of the Week
8-7.text: Allen 26.56, Gibbs 24.8, Warren 21.3. Waddle's 14.9 sat for Magnificent.

honor.title: Big CeeDeez Nuts
honor.text: One of three perfect lineups this week, and the highest of them at 121.32. A week earlier: a season-low 76.82.

11-12.headline: The Throne Falls to Kazakhstan
11-12.text: {S11} came in 3–4 and dethroned first place. Bowers 28.2, Bass 16.0. {S12} got 39.48 from Burrow, went 9–2 in all-play and lost anyway. Perfect lineup still short.

5-1.headline: Flowers Wilt, Chimpanzini Streak Dies
5-1.text: {S1}'s three-game streak died with Zay Flowers and Will Reichard at 0.0 each. {S5} played a zero at flex, left nothing on the bench and won by 22.2.

8-7.headline: Beefy Boys Bury the Magnificent
8-7.text: {S8} posted the week's high, 154.16, and went 11–0 in all-play. Pollard 28.7 from the flex, again. {S7} arrived 5–2 and got 8.28 from Stafford.
